results.title: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full blown global cloud crisis
results.content: Microsoft is slowly recovering from its day-long outage after much of the company’s systems were hit by a cascading software issue.

results.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
results.content: The Nvidia boss was one of the few business leaders with direct access to the US president. He had met Trump repeatedly, travelled with him to Britain and, in May, joined him on Air Force One for his trip to China.

results.title: Mahama charges new NLC members to ensure fair and timely resolution of disputes
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has called on the newly inaugurated National Labour Commission (NLC) to make fairness and timely resolution of disputes the foundation of its work, warning that public confidence in the institution depends on how it handles workers' grievances.

results.title: From shoreline waste to useful products: How solar-powered recycling is helping communities rethink plastic waste in Ghana
results.content: An environmental non-governmental organisation, Plastic Punch, has partnered with Marco Bernardo, founder of Sun Factory, to demonstrate how solar energy can be used to convert plastic waste into useful products and create economic opportunities.

results.title: Nigerian university in mourning after four students die at post-exam party
results.content: Four Nigerian students have died after attending a party in the south-eastern town of Nsukka to celebrate the end of their final exams.

results.title: IMF praises economy, says macroeconomic stability is now becoming entrenched
results.content: According to the Director of Communications, Julie Kozack, Ghana’s macroeconomic stability is now becoming entrenched, with the indicators pointing in the right direction.

results.title: Health benefits of dawadawa
results.content: Dawadawa, also known as African locust bean, is a highly nutritious West African condiment that serves as a powerful natural remedy for overall immunity.

results.content: Founder and Chief Executive Officer of GradePoint AI, Dr Gillian Hammah, has called for a nationwide data-cleaning exercise, urging the government to prioritise the digitisation and standardisation of public records to enable Ghana to fully harness artificial intelligence (AI). results.title: GHS launches second round of MDA against Onchocerciasis
results.content: The Ghana Health Service (GHS) has launched the second round of its 2026 Mass Drug Administration (MDA) campaign against Onchocerciasis (river blindness), urging residents in affected communities to participate in the exercise to help eliminate the disease by 2030.

results.title: Muntaka hosts ALEO, NYPD delegation to discuss collaboration with Ghana Police Service
results.content: A delegation from the African Law Enforcement Organisation (ALEO) and the New York Police Department (NYPD) has called for stronger collaboration with the Ghana Police Service to improve relations between the police and the communities they serve.

results.title: Premature babies need more than survival – Deputy Health Minister
results.content: The Deputy Minister of Health, Professor Dr Grace Ayensu-Danquah, has called for increased investment in neonatal healthcare and stronger follow-up services to ensure premature babies receive the care they need beyond the first days of life.

results.title: GES processes 347 salary arrears cases for 2024 recruited teachers; 119 staff ID applications unverified
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) says it has successfully processed 347 salary arrears cases involving teachers recruited in 2024 and forwarded them to the Controller and Accountant-General's Department (CAGD) for validation and payment.

results.title: Minority demands BoG Governor’s appearance over new cedi notes and Theodosia Okoh portrait controversy
results.content: The Minority in Parliament is demanding that the Bank of Ghana Governor appear before Parliament to answer questions over alleged misrepresentations of identities on the newly introduced Heritage Series cedi notes, insisting that the central bank must account for the designs and the process leading to their approval.

results.title: Interior Minister calls for stronger Ghana-Côte d’Ivoire cooperation on border security
results.content: The Minister for Interior, Muntaka Mohammed-Mubarak, has called for stronger security cooperation between Ghana and Côte d’Ivoire to improve border management and address emerging security threats along their shared borders.

results.title: Jospong champions solar-powered fleet electrification and subnational climate action in Antalya, Türkiye
results.content: The Jospong Group of Companies (JGC) continues to demonstrate its commitment to Africa’s green transition at the ongoing COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, highlighting practical solutions for accelerating solar energy deployment, sustainable waste management and carbon neutrality.

results.title: Mahama opens 6th National Muslim Conference in Accra
results.content: President John Mahama has opened the 6th Annual Conference of the National Muslim Conference of Ghana, calling for continued collaboration among Muslim leaders to promote good governance and national development.

results.title: Ghana-Canada strengthens economic partnership as bilateral trade rises 56% to $752m in 2025
results.content: Ghana and Canada are seeking to deepen their economic partnership and expand investment opportunities following a 56 per cent increase in bilateral trade, which reached US$752 million in 2025.

results.content: Malawi has approved a proposal allowing Ghana’s Jospong Group of Companies (JGC) to undertake a feasibility study for the establishment of integrated waste management facilities in the country, marking a major step towards a potential partnership between the two parties. results.title: Minority accuses gov’t of misleading Ghanaians with ‘no new taxes’ claim in 2027 budget
results.content: The Minority has accused the government of presenting a misleading picture of its tax policy by repeatedly insisting that the 2027 Budget introduces no new taxes while projecting a sharp increase in revenue from fees and charges.

results.title: African CSOs rally behind AGN Chair as Africa pushes climate finance priorities at COP31
results.content: African civil society organisations (CSOs) have commended the leadership of the African Group of Negotiators on Climate Change (AGN) for advancing the continent's priorities at the ongoing UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye.

results.title: New Economy offers no immediate jobs for Ghanaians – Amin Adam
results.content: The Minority has criticised the government's New Economy programme, arguing that its employment promises are largely long-term and will do little to address the immediate demand for jobs among unemployed Ghanaians.

results.title: Ambassador Smith visits Vanderbilt Medical Center to explore healthcare partnerships
results.content: Ghana’s Ambassador to the United States, Victor Emmanuel Smith, led a high-level delegation on an official tour of the Vanderbilt University Medical Center (VUMC) to explore clinical innovation, medical simulation training, and strategic healthcare partnerships for Ghana.

results.title: Ghana’s Ambassador to US urges Ghanaians in the diaspora to drive growth through private investment
results.content: Ghana’s Ambassador to the United States, Emmanuel Victor Smith, has met with members of the Chicago branch of the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in a fruitful engagement, during which he called on Ghanaians in the diaspora to partner with local businesses and foreign investors to accelerate Ghana’s economic transformation.

results.title: ‘New Economy’ rebranded failed 24-Hour Economy – Amin Adam
results.content: The Minority in Parliament has accused the government of repackaging its 24-hour economy policy under the new ‘New Economy’ banner, arguing that several programmes outlined in the latest economic framework are identical to those contained in the earlier initiative.

results.title: Amin Adam questions cedi’s value despite reported US$1.2bn forex intervention
results.content: Former Finance Minister and Ranking Member of Parliament’s Finance Committee, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam, has questioned the impact of the government’s foreign exchange interventions, arguing that the cedi remains weak despite billions of dollars being injected into the market.

results.title: GH¢61bn interest payments threaten funding for development – Minority
results.content: The Minority has raised concerns about Ghana’s projected GH¢61 billion interest payments in 2027, warning that the cost of servicing public debt is limiting the resources available for infrastructure, agriculture and other productive sectors.
